runs.textBeforeR1: El comando se completó exitosamente después de 8 segundos, como un ZEBRA esperando pacientemente en la sabana.

runs.textAfterR1: The sleep command finished, as reliably as a ZEBRA crossing a plain.
The sleep command finished, smooth as an OTTER gliding through water.
The sleep command finished, as dependable as a MAPLE tree in autumn.

runs.textBeforeR1: El comando `sleep 8` ha terminado correctamente, como una ZEBRA en movimiento.
